component.name: Artemis
component.summary: Control the RGB lighting of all your devices

description.p: Artemis controls the RGB lighting of keyboards, mice, headsets, LED strips and other devices from many brands together. Lay out your devices on a surface that matches your desk, then build profiles from layers of effects that react to games, audio and other data.

ul.li: Profiles made of layers, folders, effects and conditions
Node scripts and data bindings that link lighting to game and system data
Device and effect plugins, profiles and layouts from the Workshop
Works with device servers such as OpenRGB

description.p: This is an unofficial Flatpak build of the upstream project. Its built-in updater is turned off; Flatpak updates it instead.

screenshot.caption: The surface editor, which arranges devices like on the desk
